data.title: Claude Code Review leaves preview
data.summary: The October 15 release makes hosted reviews generally available to Team and Enterprise organizations.

sources.title: Code Review is now generally available

facts.text: Anthropic announced Code Review general availability on October 15 for Team and Enterprise, with repository-level Quick, Standard and Deep review settings.

prerequisites: Identify the intended host, task, source data and existing access.
steps: Check whether the existing organization already enabled the GitHub App and target repository.
Compare findings on a small authorized pull request against its tests and diff.
Evaluate false positives and missed issues; retain the project’s normal merge controls.
data.output: A scoped evaluation of hosted review against known defects.
validation: A finding includes a concrete trigger and file location.
A clean review is not treated as proof that code is correct.
limitations: Provider announcement; Sintra did not install the GitHub App, purchase a service or validate review performance.
